EXAMPLE BODY · TEST DOCUMENT · NOT REAL RULES




Example Combat Rules
V.1.1 · 01.06.2026
Invented for software testing only.

1. General
1.1 Scope
These invented rules apply to every example bout and every example
tournament held under the Example Body.
1.2 Grounded fighter
A fighter is grounded when any part of the body other than the feet
touches the ground. A grounded fighter takes no further part in the
round.

2. Prohibited actions
2.1 Prohibited targets
Strikes to the back of the knee, the neck, the groin and the feet are
prohibited. See 1.2 for grounded fighters.
2.2 Grappling
Grappling is allowed only while both fighters stand. Throws onto the
head are prohibited.
2.3 Two-handed weapons
A two-handed weapon must be held with both hands when striking. A
shield may not be used to strike with its edge.

3. Penalties


                               Page 1 of 2

3.1 Warnings
The marshal may give a verbal warning for a minor breach.
3.2 Cards
A yellow card is shown for a repeated breach; a red card removes the
fighter from the bout (see 3.1).

4. Equipment
4.1 Helmet
Every fighter wears a helmet that covers the whole head and the
neck.
